shared: This scene contains YUN, a finished Street Yun chibi character (total height 0.672 m, feet at z=0, facing -Y, arms straight out sideways in a T-pose). She is the template for the whole roster: build a NEW character from her by keeping her body construction and changing the hair, colors, outfit details and accessories. KEEP these objects with exactly the same shape, size and position (recolor only): Head (skin head box with the ears), Eyes, Eyebrows, Mouth, Cheeks, Torso, Jacket, CropTop, Collar, Shorts, Leg_L, Leg_R, Shoe_L, Shoe_R, Arm_L, Arm_R, Hand_L, Hand_R, Bag, Bag_Strap, Belt. DELETE these Yun-only objects: Hair_Curls, Hair_Ponytail, Scrunchie, Earrings, Hip_Strap. Owner's rules: the head box keeps its wide flat jaw; the new hair is built as one soft clay-like shape that follows the head box (rounded clumps), starting at the hairline or as bangs, covering the top, sides and back with no skin showing through; total height including hair about 0.67-0.72 m; head-with-hair width at most about 0.48 m unless the design says otherwise. Every material you create or recolor gets a new name starting with the character's name (e.g. Riko_Hair, Riko_Jacket) so the template's Yun_ materials are not shared. Name new objects by body part so rigging works: hair pieces Hair_*, hats Hat_* or Cap_*, glasses Glasses, goggles Goggles, headphones worn on the head Headphones, anything worn around the neck Neckwear_*. Flat colors, soft bevels, smooth shading, under 25000 triangles, and every new piece must touch what it sits on.

characters.name: Riko
characters.spec: RIKO. Skin: light peach #F2C6A4 (recolor the Head skin and any skin parts). Hair: warm chestnut brown #8B4A2B: thick blunt bangs cut straight across the forehead just above the eyes, straight side locks falling beside the cheeks down to the jaw, the back covering the head, and a big HIGH PONYTAIL tied at the top-back with a bright pink #F06AA8 scrunchie ring, the tail sweeping up and curving down behind the head to about shoulder height. Outfit: bomber jacket in hot pink #E8508A with black #1E1E22 panels on the front and black cuffs, a small white star detail on the chest; Collar = pink-and-white hoodie collar; Torso and CropTop = white/pink inner hoodie (no bare midriff). Shorts black. Hands: skin mitten hands with black fingerless gloves and pink wristbands. Sneakers: white with pink #F06AA8 panels and white soles. Bag and strap black with a small pink patch on the bag.

characters.name: Kai
characters.spec: KAI. Skin: light peach #F0C8A2. Hair: very dark navy #1E2233, messy SPIKY anime hair: pointed spiky clumps all over the top and back sticking up and out, spiky bangs falling over the forehead to the brows, side spikes covering the tops of the ears. Outfit: jacket in royal blue #2F6BD8 with white cuffs and a white hood/collar; Torso, CropTop = white t-shirt (no bare midriff). Neckwear_Phones: chunky over-ear headphones resting around the neck, white/light-grey earcups with black rims, a black band behind the neck, the earcups sitting on the collar at both sides. Shorts black cargo. Hands: skin mitten hands with black wrist bands. Sneakers: white with royal blue panels. Bag and strap black.

characters.name: Luna

Hair: lavender purple #A47BE6 with lighter purple #C29BF2 highlights: blunt bangs across the forehead, TWO BIG ROUND BUNS on the top-left and top-right of the head (each bun about 0.12 m wide), and long wavy hair falling down both sides of the face past the shoulders to about waist height (side curtains hanging in front of the shoulders, touching the jacket), the back covered. A yellow #F2C04D five-point star hair clip on her right side above the bangs (Hair_Clip). Outfit: purple #8F5BD8 hoodie-jacket with white #F4F1EE puffy forearm sleeves (the outer half of each arm white), small yellow star patches on the chest; Torso, CropTop = black inner top (no bare midriff); Collar purple hood.
